decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses

response.rationale: Systemic lymphoma best explains retroperitoneal/adrenal masses, constitutional symptoms, and atypical dermal infiltrate; antibiotics failure and biopsy exclude infection. Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is too narrow given systemic masses.

rejected.why: Skin-only diagnosis; lacks systemic retroperitoneal/adrenal involvement.
Antibiotic failure and atypical cells contradict pyomyositis.
No granulomas or other sarcoid-specific features; atypical cells favor neoplasm.
No histiocytic markers or specific histology; systemic lymphoma more consistent.
